conditions: Prices are for loading and hauling by volume — how much space your items take up in the truck.
Heavy material (concrete, dirt, brick, roofing shingles) is limited by weight, not just volume, and may be priced separately.
Items with special disposal fees — like mattresses, tires, refrigerators and other appliances with refrigerant — can carry an added charge.
Difficult access (long carries, several flights of stairs, tight crawlspaces) can add labor.
Demolition labor is quoted separately from hauling.
We confirm the final price on-site, before we start. If it's more than you expected, you can say no.
